column_description: A CHAR(12) primary key uniquely identifying each moderation action record (e.g., 'MA0000001234').
A CHAR(12) referencing SecurityDetection(SecDetKey) (e.g., 'SD1234567890').
A CHAR(12) referencing ContentBehavior(CntRef) (e.g., 'CB1234567890').
A SMALLINT counting how many abuse reports (e.g., '2').
A JSONB mapping violation types (e.g., '{"spam":5, "hate":1}').
An enum (SuspensionHistory_enum) detailing past suspensions (0 through 5).
A SMALLINT showing how many warnings were issued (e.g., '1').
An enum (AppealCount_enum) for how many appeals were filed (0 through 5).
A SMALLINT counting linked/sockpuppet accounts (e.g., '3').
A SMALLINT representing the size of the related account cluster (e.g., '10').
An enum (ClusterRole_enum) labeling the user’s cluster role (Isolated, Follower, Leader, Amplifier).
A NUMERIC(5,2) rating network influence (e.g., '7.85').
A NUMERIC(4,2) measuring coordinated behavior (e.g., '0.73').
A NUMERIC(5,3) rating authenticity (e.g., '0.745').
A NUMERIC(4,1) rating credibility (e.g., '7.9').
A NUMERIC(5,4) user’s reputation measure (e.g., '0.8943').
A NUMERIC(4,2) capturing trust level (e.g., '0.60').
A NUMERIC(4,3) rating the potential impact of the violation (e.g., '1.034').
An enum (MonitoringPriority_enum) indicating how closely to watch (Low, Medium, Urgent, High).
An enum (InvestigationStatus_enum) describing investigation status (Pending, Active, Completed).
An enum (ActionTaken_enum) summarizing final moderation (Suspension, Warning, Restriction).
An enum (ReviewFrequency_enum) describing re-review frequency (Monthly, Quarterly, Daily, Weekly).
A DATE showing last moderation review (e.g., '2025-03-20').
A DATE scheduling the next moderation review (e.g., '2025-04-20').
